aggregation: mean of three seeds within each geometry, mean of geometries within each provenance group, equal mean over 63 groups
comparison_sign: comparator minus PhyTCR-Net; positive favors PhyTCR-Net

bootstrap.primary: paired source-group resampling within each fixed outer fold, preserving that fold's group count
bootstrap.sensitivity: unstratified paired resampling over all63 source groups
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile, numpy linear quantiles 0.025 and0.975
bootstrap.conditioning: fixed outer folds, saved model predictions, seed averages and provenance-group assignments

per_geometry_RMSE: sqrt(mean((prediction-truth)^2)) over 64 times and valid sections
wave_RMSE: sqrt(mean((error-time_mean(error))^2)) over valid sections and times
signed_mean_error: mean time-mean error over valid sections
adjacent_pressure_error: RMSE of predicted-minus-CFD directed-edge pressure differences where both node masks are True
local_flow_RMS: RMS of prediction minus local_target_raw for each local_edges entry
checkpoint_selection: minimum inner-validation S; same selected parameters for P and Q
